# Preference: Communication Style

## Statement

Alex prefers direct and concise communication, avoiding filler and getting to the point quickly.

## Context

Direct communication means saying what needs to be said without excessive hedging or preamble.
Feedback should be specific and actionable rather than vague or overly diplomatic.
Alex values brevity in written messages and avoids long preambles.
This style applies in both professional and personal contexts.
